title: Dynamic System Inspired Continuous Large Language Model for AI4Science Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.26959v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific foundation models increasingly operate on continuous phenomena, yet still use discrete residual computation. We ask whether pretrained residual transformations can support additional latent computation without expanding the backbone. To test this possibility, we introduce Continuum-LM, which reuses these transformations as dynamical operators in a continuous-depth language model. Its hidden states evolve through an ordinary differential equation evaluated by higher-order numerical integration, with solver order and step size controlling computation. Across eight scientific tasks, Continuum-LM trains stably and improves mean exact-match accuracy by 7.77 and 10.96 percentage points over discrete counterparts at the 0.6B and 1.7B scales, respectively. translated_title: 基于动力系统启发的面向AI4Science任务的连续大语言模型
translated_abstract: 科学基础模型日益需要处理连续现象，但它们仍然使用离散的残差计算。我们提出这样的问题：预训练的残差变换能否在不扩展主干网络的情况下支持额外的潜在计算。为验证这一可能性，我们提出了Continuum-LM，它将这些残差变换复用为连续深度语言模型中的动力学算子。其隐藏状态通过常微分方程进行演化，并采用高阶数值积分进行求解，其中求解器的阶数和步长控制着计算量。在八项科学任务上，Continuum-LM训练稳定，在0.6B和1.7B参数规模下，平均精确匹配准确率分别比离散对应模型提升了7.77和10.96个百分点。在0.6B规模下，在匹配的参数量和残差函数评估预算下，它还优于Ouro风格的循环控制模型。这些结果共同支持了可扩展的计算……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Continuum-LM将预训练的残差变换复用为动力系统算子，构建了通过常微分方程演化隐藏状态的连续深度语言模型，在不扩展主干网络的前提下增加了潜在计算能力，在八项科学任务上将平均精确匹配准确率显著提升了7.77至10.96个百分点。
en_tdlr: Continuum-LM reuses pretrained residual transformations as dynamical operators in a continuous-depth language model whose hidden states evolve via an ODE, enabling additional latent computation without expanding the backbone and improving mean exact-match accuracy by 7.77 and 10.96 percentage points across eight scientific tasks.
